decisions.decision: The Cemetery Commission recommended that the Select Board move forward with seeking American Rescue Plan Act funding for a New England Rustic Field-Stone Wall rather than Hemlock Hedges. This is a commission recommendation; the minutes record no Select Board action.
decisions.quote: the cemetery commission recommended to the select board members to move forward with securing from the american rescue plan act

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The estimated replacement cost of the Hemlock hedges is stated as approximately $185K.
budget_items.quote: replacement cost of hemlock hedges are estimated at approximately $185k.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The preferred New England Rustic Field-Stone Wall is estimated at approximately $288K to $388K, presented as lower life-cycle cost than hedges.

budget_items.topic: Stone wall price per face foot
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Ramsden estimate prices the free-standing wall at $40.00 per face foot over 6,180 square face feet.
budget_items.quote: a 6,180 square face feet of free- standing rustic semi formal dry, stacked - new england field-stone wall at $40.00 per face feet.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Commission requests $350K for the Restoration of North Cemetery Boundaries.
budget_items.quote: $350k for restoration of north cemetery boundaries.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: One year of watering the new trees is estimated at $3K to be borne by the Cemetery Commission and DPW.
budget_items.quote: one year of watering will cost the cemetery commission and dpw - estimated at $3k.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A well for the new plantings is estimated at $25K or more, excluding pump, piping and electricity; tie-in to the Highland Street water system is listed as a possible alternative with cost to be determined.
budget_items.quote: additional cost of $25k or more for a well to be drilled.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Professional hedge trimming is amortized at $500.00 a year, with trimming at 3-4 year intervals estimated at $2,000.00 per incident.
budget_items.quote: trimming may be required at 3 - 4 year intervals at estimated $2,000.00 per incident.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Three seasons of watering for the hemlocks is described as cost prohibitive, with no figure printed.
budget_items.quote: three seasons of water needs to be complete, which is going to be cost prohibitive

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Commission says it will support a Select Board request to use the Stabilization Fund at the Fall Town Meeting so more funds are available for ARPA distribution; no dollar figure is printed.
budget_items.quote: use the stabilization fund at this fall's town meeting, so more funds are available for arpa distribution.
